prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one original fashion editorial photograph for a clearly fictional concept portfolio. A full-length adult female fashion model wearing an unbranded charcoal oversized wool coat, cream knit top, straight dark trousers and understated black shoes, walking naturally beside a warm limestone wall, autumn midday light. The outfit is invented, not a real retailer SKU. Minimal premium European editorial style, honest fabric texture, natural face and hands, sophisticated asymmetric framing, negative space at upper left for typography that will be added separately. Portrait aspect ratio 4:5, single image not a collage, realistic anatomy. No brand logos, no text, no watermark, no accessories with recognizable trademarks.
